config.title: Markdown Read Aloud
config.engine.description: Which text-to-speech engine to use. Edge sends the text being read to Microsoft's online read-aloud service; Supertonic and System voices stay on this machine. This is a user-level trust decision, so workspace settings cannot change it.
config.engine.enum.edge: Microsoft Edge neural voices — free, cloud quality, sends the text being read to Microsoft over the internet
config.engine.enum.supertonic: Supertonic — offline neural voices via a local server you start yourself with "supertonic serve" (first start downloads ~260 MB of model files; after that it is fully local). If the server is not running, reading stops with instructions — text is never silently sent online
config.engine.enum.browser: System voices via the browser engine — works offline, lower quality (last resort)
config.preferredGender.description: Preferred voice gender when auto-selecting a voice for a language.
config.speed.description: Default playback speed (0.5×–2.5×). Adjustable live in the player.
config.volume.description: Default playback volume (0–1). Adjustable live in the player.
config.autoDetectLanguage.description: Detect the document's main language automatically and pick a matching voice.
config.perParagraphLanguage.description: Switch the voice per paragraph to match each paragraph's language (for mixed-language docs). Off by default: one consistent voice is easier to follow. Toggle live in the player.
config.fallbackLanguage.description: Language (BCP-47) to use when detection is unreliable or unsupported.
config.voiceOverrides.description: Advanced: override the voice per language, e.g. `{ "de-DE": "de-DE-KatjaNeural" }`. Open the player to see voice IDs.
config.announceHeadings.description: Say "Heading" before each heading. Off by default (gets repetitive).
config.codeBlocks.description: How to handle fenced code blocks.
config.codeBlocks.enum.announce: Say "code block" instead of reading the code
config.tables.description: How to handle tables. Reading them aloud is usually noisy.
config.highlightWhileReading.description: Highlight and scroll to the sentence currently being read in the editor.
config.pronunciations.description: Pronunciation overrides applied before speech synthesis. Keys are words (matched case-insensitively on word boundaries) or literal substrings; values are what gets spoken instead — e.g. `{ "nginx": "engine x", "kubectl": "kube control" }`. Put it in workspace settings to share a project dictionary with your team.
